title: Burning USDS refunds mint capacity rather than consuming a burn allowance, making the limit a net exposure cap
content:
A.6.1.1.2.2.6.1.2.2.1.2.1.2.1.2.2 spells out an easily-missed property: "Burning USDS **restores** previously consumed mint capacity. The operator's call increases (refunds) the `LIMIT_USDS_MINT` rate limit by `usdsAmount`, reversing the decrease applied when that USDS was minted. Internally `_cancelRateLimit` calls `rateLimits.triggerRateLimitIncrease(LIMIT_USDS_MINT, usdsAmount)`; **it does not check or consume a separate burn allowance**."

This converts `LIMIT_USDS_MINT` from a flow limit into a **position limit**. A gross-flow limit would count every mint against a daily budget regardless of subsequent repayment, so an operator rebalancing frequently would exhaust the allowance without ever increasing exposure. Refunding on burn means the consumed amount tracks **outstanding debt**, not cumulative activity.

Two consequences follow. Repayment is **never blocked** — there is no allowance to run out of, so Grove can always deleverage, which is the same principle as the uncapped homeward bridging path (A.6.1.1.2.2.6.1.2.1.1.3.1.2.3). And round-tripping is free, so operational churn does not consume risk budget.

The trade-off is that the limit no longer bounds *velocity* of minting. An operator can mint, burn and re-mint repeatedly within a day, exceeding the nominal daily figure in gross terms while never exceeding it in net terms.

This also sits awkwardly with A.6.1.1.2.2.6.1.2.1.1.3.1.1.2, which lists a `LIMIT_USDS_BURN` parameter for the monolithic controller on Ethereum Mainnet (value "to be specified in a future iteration"). If burning consumes no burn allowance, it is unclear what that parameter would govern — the parameter list and the function specification do not obviously describe the same system.
description: burnUSDS triggers a rate limit increase on LIMIT_USDS_MINT and 'does not check or consume a separate burn allowance', so unwinding is always permitted and restores headroom immediately.
